name: @unloaded/mcp-server
description: Local MCP server (stdio) over one structural project: IFC model(s) (or a *.calcgraph.json project file) mapped to calc-package PDFs by @unloaded/calc-mapper, with @unloaded/element-graph connectivity and @unloaded/move-impact what-ifs. The engineer's own AI queries elements, calcs, links, evidence, findings, typical groups, load path, impact and revision diffs, and records review decisions to an append-only decisions file.
